meta.title: animal-icons
meta.format: 60 s big-game animal epic, cut to 30 s and 15 s
meta.picture_area: 2.20:1 letterbox inside 1920x1080: black bars y 0-103 and 977-1080 (9.6% each); picture 1920x874

acts.name: Meeting
acts.function: a newborn draft foal on a ranch finds a downy eaglet under a fallen log; tenderness, quiet intro music

acts.name: Storm
acts.function: the eaglet alone in a night storm; the foal goes out and shelters it; the band and the vocal enter on the shelter

acts.name: Winter
acts.function: seasons pass: tracks side by side in the snow, the yearling on the farm

acts.name: Lessons
acts.function: summer: the young eagle rides the running yearling and tries to fly, falls, tries again; ranchers watch

acts.name: Grown
acts.function: the grown horse charges; the eagle spreads its wings behind it (the winged-horse image) and finally flies free

acts.name: Product and tag
acts.function: glass of lager on the rail, tagline, the rancher's dry joke, end card

cut30.arc: Hook 0-5.55: foal in the barn door, the eaglet's-eye look, the first touch, dusk tableau, all on the quiet intro. Middle 5.55-17.88: the storm starts with the rain on the score join, the foal shelters the eaglet as the band crashes in (10.08), then 'free as a bird now' carries winter, the first failed flight, the canter, the grown horse charging and the winged-horse image. Payoff 17.88-24.37: the score jumps to the climax, the eagle lifts off the horse on 'won't you fly high', glass and tagline on 'free bird'. Tag and end card 24.37-30.0: 'You crying?' / 'Sun's in my eyes.', eagle over the golden field, {BRAND}.
